notes.title: UPDATE 0.38! GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/cd51d5547c11fb4253807b80989288bf40f261a1.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.38.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, we've recently replaced the previous environmental effects with a better [b]UV system[/b] and introduced a new craftable [b]Gyrocopter[/b] as part of the end-game scenario!

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1462966762731355827]0.37.02 NEW GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM, ALOE AND MORE![/url]

A short recap ---

[quote]This update adds more to our end-game scenario. It has always been our plan for the player to be rescued by helicopter after completing a series of objectives, but recently we thought ‘Why don’t we let the player build their [i]own[/i] helicopter?’ ...and so in this build you can now build your very own [b]Gyrocopter[/b] in true MacGyver style! You will need to collect all the parts to build the Gyrocopter which you can do by completing the new missions. The Gyrocopter will eventually form part of the final end-game story/event.

This update also addresses the controversial new environmental status effects. After seeing how they were playing out and listening to player feedback we realise we took a few missteps. The most obvious is that players weren’t able to manage the effects other than limiting exposure, which meant hiding under a tree or sitting next to a fire for x hours – not fun. The flu was just annoying so we’ve removed it and focused on making the sun a better and more manageable threat.[/quote]

Please see the patch notes linked above for more info on the new UV system, but TL/DR:
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
-- 

[h1][b]0.36.00-0.38.00 STABLE CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added [b]Sunburn[/b] status effect.
- Removed [b]Heatstroke[/b] status effect.
- Removed [b]Flu[/b] status effect.
- Added [b]Vertical Swimming[/b] movement with [Jump] and [Crouch] controls.
- Removed [b]Shark[/b] respawning.
- Removed [b]Firetorch[/b] and [b]Refined Axe[/b]  from loot.
- Removed [Jump] button cancelling vehicle operation.
- Increased [b]Underwater Breath[/b] by 15 seconds.
- Increased [b]Water Still[/b] refill time from 0.2 hours to 1.0 hours.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Atmospheric[/b] and [b]Underwater Fog[/b] drawing over transparent effects - crafting ghost, smoke, etc.
- Fixed display name repeating for empty [b]Fire Torches[/b].
- Fixed different sound effects for [b]Drinking[/b] and [b]Eating.[/b]
- Fixed [b]Quick Crafting[/b] and [b]Crafting[/b] menu not refreshing Hud UI on close.
- Fixed Player [b]Status Effects[/b] not saving correct display names.
- Fixed teleporting to operating position when first operating [b]Rafts.[/b]
- Fixed being able to place [b]Bed Shelter[/b] in mid air.
- Fixed being able to place [b]Farming Plot[/b] in mid air.
- Fixed terrain generating sharp edges on [b]Shorelines[/b].
- Fixed player [b]Super Jump[/b] when jumping near shorelines.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- Added new [b]Aloe Plant[/b] to cure [b]Sunburn[/b].
- Added new [b]Aloe Salve[/b] to prevent [b]Sunburn[/b].
- Added new [b]UV Index[/b] display on Watch.
- Added new [b]Heatwave[/b] display on Watch.
- Added new [b]Gyrocopter[/b] craftable vehicle!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Frame[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Seat[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Motor[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Cockpit[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Rotors[/b] mission reward!

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Changed [b]Player[/b] code structure to support multiple players in a scene in the future.
- Changed [b]Watch[/b] to load from external bundle to support custom watches in the future.
- Optimized [b]Buoyancy[/b] by calculating wave positions for all buoyant objects in a single batch.

notes.title: 0.37 EXP. UPDATE! NEW GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM, ALOE AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/0aba409f27a624f447f087eb3865fe8c5a735164.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.37.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This update adds more to our end-game scenario. It has always been our plan for the player to be rescued by helicopter after completing a series of objectives, but recently we thought ‘Why don’t we let the player build their [i]own[/i] helicopter?’ ...and so in this build you can now build your very own [b]Gyrocopter[/b] in true MacGyver style!
    
You will need to collect all the parts to build the Gyrocopter which you can do by completing the new missions. There’s a few Gyro parts unlocked for the time being while we finish off the rest of the missions. The Gyrocopter will eventually form part of the final end-game story/event.

This update also addresses the controversial new environmental status effects. After seeing how they were playing out and listening to player feedback we realise we took a few missteps. The most obvious is that players weren’t able to manage the effects other than limiting exposure, which meant hiding under a tree or sitting next to a fire for x hours – not fun. The flu was just annoying so we’ve removed it and focused on making the sun a better and more manageable threat. 
    
The effect of the sun on the player now correlates to a ‘UV Index’ shown on your watch. The UV Index is an indicator of harmful solar UV radiation. It ranges from Low, Medium, High, Very High and Extreme. It is affected by the time of year with the months from June-September being the most deadly. This will be tied into a game setting in the future, but just keep that in mind if you’re finding the sun too intense. There are also heatwaves which increase temperatures and the UV index. When there is a heatwave the temperature icon is replaced with a heatwave icon on the watch display. The UV index affects how quickly you burn from the sun:

    11+ Extreme – 1 hour
    8-10 Very High – 2 hours
    6-7 High – 4 hours
    3-5 Moderate – 5 hours
    1-2 Low – Effectively never.

If you are exposed for the corresponding amount of time you will get [b]Sunburn[/b] effect. This effect drains your thirst and hunger until it has worn off. The new method to remove Sunburn is to use the new plant, [b]Aloe[/b]. You can find Aloe dotted around islands like other plants and it allows you to cure a Sunburn immediately. Aloe is also farmable. As you progress you will also be able to craft an [b]Aloe Salve[/b] to cure and prevent Sunburn from happening. Aloe Salves will be incorporated with a new station and arm effects in a coming update. As before, you can also find shade for x game hours to remove Sunburn.

Once you have Sunburn it will deplete your thirst and hunger completely within 2 game hours. This gives you plenty of time to find shade or Aloe. Keep in mind that even when your hunger and thirst are fully depleted it still takes approx. 3 game days to deplete your health (if you have no other status effects). So you have quite a lot of time to fix your problems!

The temperature shown on your watch now displays the ‘apparent temperature’ which is how hot it actually feels based on the humidity. This temperature currently doesn’t contribute to any status effects, but we may look at restoring Heatstroke based on the apparent temperature – However, sometimes realism doesn’t equal fun!

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.[/h1]

There’s also been some large changes to the backend to support some upcoming features so we appreciate letting us know of any new bugs you find.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
-- 

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added [b]Sunburn[/b] status effect.
- Removed [b]Heatstroke[/b] status effect.

notes.title: 0.37 EXP. UPDATE! NEW GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM, ALOE AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/0aba409f27a624f447f087eb3865fe8c5a735164.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.37.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This update adds more to our end-game scenario. It has always been our plan for the player to be rescued by helicopter after completing a series of objectives, but recently we thought ‘Why don’t we let the player build their [i]own[/i] helicopter?’ ...and so in this build you can now build your very own [b]Gyrocopter[/b] in true MacGyver style!
    
You will need to collect all the parts to build the Gyrocopter which you can do by completing the new missions. There’s a few Gyro parts unlocked for the time being while we finish off the rest of the missions. The Gyrocopter will eventually form part of the final end-game story/event.

This update also addresses the controversial new environmental status effects. After seeing how they were playing out and listening to player feedback we realise we took a few missteps. The most obvious is that players weren’t able to manage the effects other than limiting exposure, which meant hiding under a tree or sitting next to a fire for x hours – not fun. The flu was just annoying so we’ve removed it and focused on making the sun a better and more manageable threat. 
    
The effect of the sun on the player now correlates to a ‘UV Index’ shown on your watch. The UV Index is an indicator of harmful solar UV radiation. It ranges from Low, Medium, High, Very High and Extreme. It is affected by the time of year with the months from June-September being the most deadly. This will be tied into a game setting in the future, but just keep that in mind if you’re finding the sun too intense. There are also heatwaves which increase temperatures and the UV index. When there is a heatwave the temperature icon is replaced with a heatwave icon on the watch display. The UV index affects how quickly you burn from the sun:

    11+ Extreme – 1 hour
    8-10 Very High – 2 hours
    6-7 High – 4 hours
    3-5 Moderate – 5 hours
    1-2 Low – Effectively never.

If you are exposed for the corresponding amount of time you will get [b]Sunburn[/b] effect. This effect drains your thirst and hunger until it has worn off. The new method to remove Sunburn is to use the new plant, [b]Aloe[/b]. You can find Aloe dotted around islands like other plants and it allows you to cure a Sunburn immediately. Aloe is also farmable. As you progress you will also be able to craft an [b]Aloe Salve[/b] to cure and prevent Sunburn from happening. Aloe Salves will be incorporated with a new station and arm effects in a coming update. As before, you can also find shade for x game hours to remove Sunburn.

Once you have Sunburn it will deplete your thirst and hunger completely within 2 game hours. This gives you plenty of time to find shade or Aloe. Keep in mind that even when your hunger and thirst are fully depleted it still takes approx. 3 game days to deplete your health (if you have no other status effects). So you have quite a lot of time to fix your problems!

The temperature shown on your watch now displays the ‘apparent temperature’ which is how hot it actually feels based on the humidity. This temperature currently doesn’t contribute to any status effects, but we may look at restoring Heatstroke based on the apparent temperature – However, sometimes realism doesn’t equal fun!

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.[/h1]

There’s also been some large changes to the backend to support some upcoming features so we appreciate letting us know of any new bugs you find.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.34.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build adds an additional [b]Mission![/b] We’ll be continuing to focus on the new mission system on the experimental branch until it’s ready to push to the stable branch. We’ve changed how missions get saved and loaded in this build so if you’ve visited or saved on a mission zone previously, there’s a good chance it won’t load back correctly in this build. We’ve also added a new save point next to the mission trigger.

The recently added player effects have been adjusted in this build. Players didn’t seem to be aware that the ‘Sunburn’ and ‘Cold’ pre-cursor effects were warning signs and didn’t have any immediate effect. So we’ve now rolled them all into single effects – Flu and Heatstroke. 

Stay Alive!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/1099dffa04f97ca3fdb934a9b500a98973c4f044.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.33.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build features new [b]Missions![/b]

There is only a single mission in this experimental update for testing the core mechanics, however there are a variety of missions in the works and they will all eventually tie into the end-game scenario.

You will need to generate a new world to generate a mission tile which appears as a skull in the Cartographer. Mission areas in the world are identified by a specific structure – a Sea Fort at the moment. You will find a mission pin-board somewhere within the Sea Fort. Interacting with the pin-board will show you details of the mission and allow you to accept or decline the mission. If you accept the mission and leave the zone, you will fail the mission. Missions can be failed and reattempted as many times as needed. 

You will also notice a new panel in your crafting menu – the Story panel. Here you will find and unlock special combinations upon completing missions or story related objectives.

Please note, the Sea Fort mission marker is not billboarding currently. This will be fixed before the new missions are released on the stable branch.

We would suggest stocking up on spears and bandages for the new mission!

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

- Added new [b]Crab[/b] attack behaviour. Crabs now do damage.
- Changed [b]Bandages[/b] to restore 2 bars of health when healing Bleeding status effect.
- Reduced [b]Weather[/b] frequency from 70% to 35%.

- New [b]Missions![/b]

- New [b]Trophies![/b] 
Unlock and collect special trophies for completing difficult missions.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.32! QUICK-CRAFTING, WEATHER, STATIONS AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/8bbeed41544de06fcde4012e92c02493d9a8e999.png[/img]

Hi everyone,	

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.32.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]
	
This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. 
If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, here’s some of the new features included: [h1][b]New Quick Crafting Menu, Weather Effects, Plank Station, Leather Waterskin, Damage Indicators and more![/b][/h1]

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1270425921141907027]0.31.00 Weather Update[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1270424470893521944]0.30.00 Quick Crafting Menu Update[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1306451998879913777]0.29.00 Player Effects, Waterskin and Plank Station Update[/url]

[b]Please note[/b] – We’ve changed the shoreline generation going forward in this build. Previously generated islands have very bumpy underwater areas and the larger waves will create unpleasant visual artefacts on these areas! It is also possible that your previously saved islands will re-generate slightly different.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

 [h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Updated [b]Weather Events[/b] to save and load state correctly.
- Reduced required attempts to start a [b]Camp Fire[/b].
- Changed [b]Crafting[/b] to only use items in the area in front of you.
- Changed [b]Watch[/b] to display the player’s status effects on additional screen.
- Changed [b]Sail[/b] and [b]Motor[/b] placement to use rotating keys. 
- Increased [b]Clay Waterbottle[/b] servings from 4 to 5.
- Added new [b]Main Menu[/b] soundtrack.
- Added [b]Inventory[/b] functionality to display health, durability or servings.
- Changed [b]Walls, Arches, Doors[/b], etc to allow 180 degree rotation when placing.
- Updated [b]Icons[/b] in Crafting menus.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed not being able to pick up [b]Logs[/b] after saving.
- Fixed [b]Ocean[/b] colors changing incorrectly when weather event assigned but not active.
- Fixed [b]Mouse Sensitivity[/b] resetting when drawing weapon.
- Fixed [b]Clay Foundation[/b] collider interfering with Steps placement.
- Fixed being able to craft building combos without Hammer, Hoe, etc.
- Fixed not being able to place [b]Hooks[/b] and [b]Shelves[/b] from previous build.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- New [b]Quick Crafting[/b] menu!
To open the new Quick Crafting menu press and hold the crafting menu key [C] for a short moment, similar to the interacting mechanic. The Quick Crafting menu won’t display if you don’t have any craftable combinations from the materials in front of you or in your backpack. If you press the crafting key [C] once without holding it, it will open the regular crafting menu.
Similar to the large crafting menu, the Quick Crafting menu uses any tools in your hands to enable and prioritize combinations shown. For eg: if you have a Hammer equipped, the Quick Crafting menu will display any available building combinations first. Likewise, if you have a Hoe equipped farming combinations will be displayed first and so on. 

- New [b]Storm Weather Effect[/b]!
With lightning and large ocean waves!

- New [b]Plank Station[/b]!
	To craft planks by riving logs.

- New [b]Leather Waterskin[/b] item!

- New [b]Player Effects![/b]
Sunburn, Heatstroke, Cold, Flu. These are long term effects, not meant to annoy, but definitely there. Adds feedback with sounds effects and animations…
This will be incorporated more fully with building tiers in a future update. Offer less protection from the elements.

- New [b]Game Over Screen[/b].

- New [b]Death animation.[/b]

- New [b]New Day Notifications![/b]

- New [b]Damage Indicators![/b]
	Subtle damage indicators to help visualize where the damage is coming from.  

- New [b]Container[/b] name stencils! 
When containers are renamed it is now shows their name as a themed stencil on the side of the container for easier object organization.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/34693fab1015b8028792f48881f348dca2cad62f.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.30.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build features the return of the [b]Quick Crafting Menu![/b] 

One of the community’s sorely missed features is back! Some players may recall when we removed the old quick crafting menu and replaced it with the larger list or book style menu. It received mixed reviews but was a necessary evil due to the sheer number of craftable combinations which resulted in the menu quickly becoming cumbersome to scroll through. The changed crafting menu was necessary and here to stay but we had always planned on reintroducing the Quick Crafting menu. The new Quick Crafting menu gets back to the roots of Stranded Deep’s crafting mechanics. It’s intended for quickly crafting objects that you know the materials for or maybe quicker crafting of the same object multiple times, like arrows. There are a lot of scenarios where you don’t need to open the large crafting menu to craft what you need. 
    
To open the new Quick Crafting menu all you need to do is press and hold the crafting menu key [C] for a short moment, similar to the interacting mechanic. The Quick Crafting menu won’t display if you don’t have any craftable combinations from the materials in front of you or in your backpack.
If you press the crafting key [C] once without holding it, it will open the regular crafting menu. The larger style crafting menu will remain as a supplementary guide, listing all the possible crafting combos.

Similar to the large crafting menu, the Quick Crafting menu uses any tools in your hands to enable and prioritize combinations shown. For eg: if you have a Hammer equipped, the Quick Crafting menu will display any available building combinations first. Likewise, if you have a Hoe equipped farming combinations will be displayed first and so on. 

The general crafting area/radius has been tightened also. The distance has been reduced and now only items in the area in front of you will count towards your crafting materials. This is important to remember, particularly for the Quick Crafting menu – If your available combos keep changing around as you move, this is more than likely why.

The Inventory now also displays an items health, durability or servings. An item’s health is represented by how ‘full’ the icon appears.

There’s also a few more smaller features like [b]New Day Notifications[/b] and [b]Damage Indicators[/b] that help add a bit more polish too.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

It received mixed reviews but was a necessary evil due to the sheer number of craftable combinations which resulted in the menu quickly becoming cumbersome to scroll through. The changed crafting menu was necessary and here to stay but we had always planned on reintroducing the Quick Crafting menu. The new Quick Crafting menu gets back to the roots of Stranded Deep’s crafting mechanics. It’s intended for quickly crafting objects that you know the materials for or maybe quicker crafting of the same object multiple times, like arrows. There are a lot of scenarios where you don’t need to open the large crafting menu to craft what you need. 
    
To open the new Quick Crafting menu all you need to do is press and hold the crafting menu key [C] for a short moment, similar to the interacting mechanic. The Quick Crafting menu won’t display if you don’t have any craftable combinations from the materials in front of you or in your backpack.
If you press the crafting key [C] once without holding it, it will open the regular crafting menu. The larger style crafting menu will remain as a supplementary guide, listing all the possible crafting combos.

Similar to the large crafting menu, the Quick Crafting menu uses any tools in your hands to enable and prioritize combinations shown. For eg: if you have a Hammer equipped, the Quick Crafting menu will display any available building combinations first. Likewise, if you have a Hoe equipped farming combinations will be displayed first and so on. 

The general crafting area/radius has been tightened also. The distance has been reduced and now only items in the area in front of you will count towards your crafting materials. This is important to remember, particularly for the Quick Crafting menu – If your available combos keep changing around as you move, this is more than likely why.

The Inventory now also displays an items health, durability or servings. An item’s health is represented by how ‘full’ the icon appears.

There’s also a few more smaller features like [b]New Day Notifications[/b] and [b]Damage Indicators[/b] that help add a bit more polish too.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

notes.title: 0.29 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD! NEW PLAYER EFFECTS, WATERSKIN, PLANK STATION AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/6205c53ec51824209e7acc95b66b84efe52e9662.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.29.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build features new [b]Player Effects, Plank Station, Leather Waterskin and more![/b]
 
The new [b]Plank Station[/b] is a craftable station that allows you to craft Planks from Logs by a process called riving. There’s a new [b]Leather Waterskin[/b] which fits nicely between Coconuts and Clay Waterbottles. There’s also new [b]Player Status Effects[/b]; You are now affected directly by the elements. You can get Sunburn by going extended periods without shelter or shade. Likewise, at night you will get Cold if you don’t have a Camp Fire to keep you warm. Effects like Sunburn and Cold are pre-cursors to more serious illnesses. You won’t experience any immediate negative side effects from these effects but they serve as a warning. Cold will develop into the Flu which will persist for a few game hours even after you are warm again, draining various vitals. Similarly, Sunburn will develop into Heatstroke. It will be important to manage your vitals during those game hours if you contract these effects. There’s different visual and audio cues for each effect and the Watch will also beep if you contract a new status effect. The Watch also displays your current status effects on a third screen, just in case you’ve missed the audio and visual cues. These effect will be incorporated more fully with building tiers in a future update where lower tiers will offer less protection from the elements.

There’s also a new feature that has been sorely missing – a [b]Game Over[/b] screen. It will display the cause of death and days survived before returning to the main screen. We’ve also added a proper death animation to make it more obvious also.

Have fun!
May the 4th be with you.. 

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Changed [b]Watch[/b] to display the player’s status effects on additional screen.
- Changed [b]Sail[/b] and [b]Motor[/b] placement to use rotating keys. 
- Increased [b]Clay Waterbottle[/b] servings from 4 to 5.
- Added new [b]Main Menu[/b] soundtrack.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Plank Station[/b]!

- New [b]Leather Waterskin[/b] item!

- New [b]Player Effects![/b]

- New [b]Game Over Screen[/b].

- New [b]Death animation.[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.28! NEW MINING, ROOFING, RESOURCES AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/6d5bd265280a08b49467b1f57117237a6c6a8595.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.28.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][I][b]IMPORTANT:  There are notes below covering the new save game location and instructions for copying over your previous save data. Please follow these instructions if you wish to preserve your old save game.[/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. 
If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, here’s some of the new features included: [h1][b]New Mining System, New Roofing System, New Clay and Rock minable resources and Pick tool, New Brick building tier, New Furnace and Brick stations and more![/b][/h1]

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/630906352211567915]New Clay resource, Brick building tier, Furnace and Brick station[/URL]
[URL= http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/630907614661156726]New Roofing system[/URL]
[URL= http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/616271552112502259]New Mining system and Minable resources[/URL]

We had been receiving emails about players not having user permissions to write world or map data. There were a few possible causes for the error, but the most common seemed to be when the game was installed in the Program Files folder and the user account didn’t have sufficient privileges or security settings. So from this stable build on we’ve changed the location of the game’s save data. You will need to do a simple copy-paste to move your old save folder to the new location. A quick guide can be found here ---
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=892983896
This also allows players with multiple users (brothers, sisters, friends, etc) to have their own unique save game data if they have their own user account on the PC.

Also a small note for Mac users: In testing we have noticed that the game needs to be launched from the Steam app or a desktop shortcut created by Steam. If the game is run directly from the .app file, Steam fails to register as initialised and you will see an error message in the game.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]0.24.01-0.28.00 CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Shipwrecks[/b] not spawning on Small Islands.
- Fixed item display names not persisting. 
- Fixed [b]Smoked Meat[/b] reverting when stored in Containers.
- Fixed [b]Water Still[/b] resetting timer when re-entering an island causing much longer waits.
- Fixed occupied or invalid building connectors blocking valid connectors behind when placing.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added Hammer mechanics to [b]Tutorial.[/b]
- Added shadows to [b]Crafting Ghost[/b] for better sense of placement depth.
- Replaced [b]Steel[/b] building tier with new [b]Clay[/b] building tier.
- Replaced [b]Buckets[/b] with new [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b].
- Changed [b]Steps[/b] placement to use rotating keys.
- Changed crafted objects to immediately pickup or store in backpack when crafted if possible.
- Changed [b]Clay Waterbottle[/b] to start off empty.
- Changed world data and save file location to use user’s special documents folder.
- Increased [b]Solar Still[/b] collection rate.
- Moved [b]Wedge Foundations[/b] and [b]Wedge Floors[/b] into Foundations and Floors crafting categories.
- Removed [b]Structural Support[/b].

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Mining[/b] system!
There’s a new tool – the [b]Refined Pick[/b] and two new minable resources – [b]Rock[/b] and [b]Clay[/b]. You can use the Pick to harvest the new resources which can be found around the islands. Rock is generally found on the islands, while Clay can be found under the water around the islands.

- New [b]Pick[/b] craftable item!
- New [b]Rock[/b] resource!
- New [b]Clay[/b] resource!

- New [b]Building Tier – Clay Bricks![/b]
The Steel building tier did not fit the survival theme of Stranded Deep so it has been replaced with a [b]Clay Brick[/b] tier. [b]Clay[/b] can be found on islands and turned into Bricks with a Furnace and Brick station.

- New [b]Brick[/b] station!
- New [b]Clay Bricks[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Foundation[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Floor[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Wall[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Half Wall[/b] building item! 
- New [b]Brick Windowed Wall[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Arch[/b] building item!

- New [b]Roof[/b] building system!
The new Roof system is the final piece to constructing an authentic looking island hut! There’s two new types of roofing – Wood/Thatched and Clay/Brick. There’s 4 different roof pieces available so you can fill in most designs. Don’t forget that you can rotate building pieces with the Q and E keys when placing. These keys can also be reassigned in the input settings. It will be important to remember to use these keys so you can place roof pieces in the correct orientation with all the different placement possibilities.

- New [b]Wood Roof Middle[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Wedge Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Cap[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Middle[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Wedge Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Cap[/b] building piece!

- New [b]Furnace[/b] station!
- New [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b] item!

- New [b]Great White Shark[/b] animal!

[h1][b]0.27.00-0.28.00 CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Skinning[/b] not allowing you to skin with a full inventory when the reward is Rawhide.
- Fixed [b]Skinnable[/b] animals not saving skinned state correctly. 
- Fixed possibility of [b]Tutorial[/b] crafting objectives not completing if auto-stored in backpack.

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Reduced performance overhead when creating and initializing new items.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/d7abd4cd15f28e3d70c5e1ab2e01c42f97025c67.png[/img][IMG]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.27.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]IMPORTANT:  There are notes below covering the new save game location and instructions for copying over your previous save data. Please follow these instructions if you wish to preserve your old save game.[/b][/h1]

This build features a new [b]Mining Tool[/b] and [b]Minable Resources![/b] There’s a new tool – the [b]Refined Pick[/b] and two new minable resources – [b]Rock[/b] and [b]Clay[/b]. You can use the Pick to harvest the new resources which can be found around the islands. Rock is generally found on the islands, while Clay can be found under the water around the islands.

We’ve been receiving emails about players not having user permissions to write world or map data. There’s a few possible causes for this error, but the most common seems to be when the game is installed in the Program Files folder and the user account doesn’t have sufficient privileges or security settings. So from this build we’ve changed the location of the game’s save data. You will need to do a simple copy-paste to move your old save folder to the new location. A quick guide can be found here ---
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=892983896
This also allows players with multiple users (brothers, sisters, friends, etc) to have their own unique save game data if they have their own user account on the PC.

Another small tweak in this build is that crafted items will automatically be picked up or stored in your backpack if possible. This saves unnecessary craft-pickup-craft-pickup scenarios.

A small note for Mac users: In testing we have noticed that the game needs to be launched from the Steam app or a desktop shortcut created by Steam. If the game is run directly from the .app file, Steam fails to register as initialised and you will see an error message in the game.

That’s it for this update. In the next week or so we’ll be moving the latest experimental updates over to the stable branch.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

notes.title: 0.26 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD! NEW ROOF BUILDING SYSTEM!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/664c843d70247e904dc6fc548241468fefc8d375.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.26.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build features the new [b]Roof Building System![/b] The new Roof system is the final piece to constructing an authentic looking island hut! There’s two new types of roofing – Wood/Thatched and Clay/Brick. There’s 4 different roof pieces available so you can fill in most designs. We’ll get a guide up soon showing some examples of the different possibilities. Don’t forget that you can rotate building pieces with the Q and E keys when placing. It will be important to remember to use these keys so you can place roof pieces in the correct orientation with all the different placement possibilities. These keys can also be reassigned in the input settings.

We’ve removed the [b]Structural Support[/b] mechanics in this build. From a developer perspective it is rewarding and cool for us to create a realistic structural support system but overall it has seemed rather unnecessary in the game. Contrary to popular belief, Stranded Deep is not intended to be a building simulator. We’ve found that players who don’t want to create unrealistic floating structures generally don’t. Those that want to build floating houses are doing no harm either. The final nail in the coffin was that the structural support system confuses and frustrates a lot of players. We get regular emails about failed placements with us pointing them to the guide. So starting from this build we’ve removed all structural support. The only minor structural support that remains is that doors on archways need to be removed before destroying the archway.

The next build will feature a new tool and a new way to gather some resources!

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

notes.title: 0.25 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD! NEW CRAFTING RESOURCE, STATIONS, BUILDING TIERS AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/03227a09fb6c415f38b1dcc41f7c0cdcef0e5b61.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.25.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features an all new crafting resource – Clay! There’s also a completely new building tier, 2 new crafting stations and more![/b][/h1]

In this update we’ve introduced a new [b]Clay[/b] resource. This has opened up a few more crafting possibilities and helps with our goal to move towards everything being craftable in the game instead of only being able to find some critical items as loot. As a result, buckets have been replaced with the new [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b]. The Steel tier has been replaced with a new [b]Clay Brick[/b] tier. As awesome as the Steel tier might have looked SD is not a game like Rust, you never [i]really[/i] needed to craft a Steel bunker... It also raised legitimate questions as to how a player would remove and transport huge chunks of steel and affix them! Yes, we still have Shipping Container Doors but they’re awesome. We still needed a top tier for progression so now the top tier is Clay Bricks. We’ve found the Clay Bricks actually feels more solid and homey than the Steel anyway which is good. The Water Distiller has been made obsolete and we’ve increased the collection rate of the Solar Still as well as fixing a small bug which had been increasing collection times of the still. We’re changing things up with the water collections side of things so bear with us while we make adjustments.

We have to emphasize that we’re not actually focusing on building at the moment. It’s more a result of getting smaller systems out of the way as we can while we work on the bigger more time-consuming systems. The next update will feature the new roofing system.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Water Still[/b] resetting timer when re-entering an island causing much longer waits.
- Fixed [b]Shipwrecks[/b] not spawning on Small Islands.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added Hammer mechanics to [b]Tutorial.[/b]
- Added shadows to [b]Crafting Ghost[/b] for better sense of placement depth.
- Increased [b]Solar Still[/b] collection rate to every 2 game hours.
- Replaced [b]Buckets[/b] with new [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b].
- Replaced [b]Steel[/b] building tier with new [b]Clay[/b] building tier.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- New [b]Building Tier – Clay Bricks![/b]
The Steel building tier did not fit the survival theme of Stranded Deep so it has been replaced with a Clay Brick tier. Clay can be found on islands and turned into Bricks with a Furnace and Brick station. Clay will be better introduced into the world later in development after testing.

notes.title: Island paradise? Stranded Deep reaches its not-so-terrible twos
notes.content: What a difference a year and a half makes. And what little difference it makes too. That’s how long it’s been since I last wrote about Stranded Deep [official site] – a game I’ve returned to during its lengthy Early Access development despite its many problems. And now it’s two years old, it’s finally shaping up into something solid and compelling. And yet at the same time, while it’s fixed so many of its issues, still doesn’t feel like it knows where it wants to go. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.24! NEW STORAGE, BUILDING MECHANICS AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/5a3858cacde90cdddccf494113484bdcbd50c8f6.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.24.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features expanded Building mechanics and the new Storage system![/b][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch – the new [b]Storage[/b] system. In case you missed our rundown of the new feature in the experimental patch notes, the mechanics are very simple and fast – if you’re looking at a container, press [Tab] to open it to display a similar radial style menu as the backpack inventory. The basic radial mechanics are the same as the inventory, except now you will see a small backpack at the bottom that you can click on to toggle between your backpack and the storage container and vice-versa. Clicking on items in either ‘container’ will transfer the item to the other container. Most containers will be able to be picked up, but containers cannot store other containers.

Every couple of months we pause to revaluate the project to make sure we’re on the right track, listen to feedback and address outstanding bugs. We’ve made some adjustments in this build based on player feedback. A few players have requested the option to choose between toggling the new radial menus open vs. the existing ‘rocker’ functionality so we’ve added an option for that in the input settings. We’ve improved the [b]Charging[/b] mechanic for projectile-based weapons so you can now stop charging a weapon without needing to wait for the charging animation to complete. It seems like a small tweak but all helps to add polish. The new Crafting menu now also keeps a bit more of a memory. Individual crafting category tabs will keep a memory of their last subcategory and scroll position until you change category. This should help speed up things like building in particular where you might use the same tab and combination multiple times. One of the bigger changes is that we’ve removed the polarizing [b]Discovery Fog[/b] feature which you can read more details on in the patch notes below. We’re also actively working on bringing back the old [b]Infinite Procedural Generation[/b]. Please bear with us while we work on integrating this system with the Cartographer. The Cartographer will still remain, providing a small starting world or ‘archipelago’ to start in. From there you can venture further out from the starting world and it will be infinite in any direction. We’re also working on an end game scenario which will require you to find rare items and put down roots on an island to piece together your recue.

We’ve noticed a lot of support emails coming in regarding missing subcategories in the new Crafting menu. 9.9/10 this is fixed by verifying the game files in Steam. It appears to be a problem with Steam’s version control between the updates as the problem is solved by verifying the files.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added reminder to craft a Shelter to [b]Save[/b] in pause menu.
- Added option for [b]Radial Menus[/b] to choose between toggle and rocker behaviour.
- Added ability to interrupt charging sequence for projectile weapons.
- Added edit and delete buttons to custom maps in the [b]Cartographer[/b].
- Added tooltip to view details of maps placed in the world when hovered over.
- Added [b]Building[/b] rotation with new key-bindings.
- Added [b]Billboard Density[/b] quality setting. 
- Changed Inventory to show slot quantity permanently.
- Changed Crafting menu to remember last subcategory and scroll position.
- Changed to not freeze movement when opening inventory.
- Increased Fibrous Leave’s inventory stack capacity.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Dragging[/b] not using current clicked position making dragging more difficult than it should be.
- Fixed animal [b]Ragdoll[/b] bones only saving position not physics related data, ie: stop Sharks flying when loaded. This fix is not retroactive but will take effect after your next save.
- Fixed projectiles interfering with [b]Ragdoll[/b] physics when killed.
- Fixed floating [b]Containers[/b] when loading a Custom Map.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Storage Menu![/b]

- New [b]Building Mechanic![/b]
Building has been expanded and broken down. Most building pieces now have 2 different stages of construction. Once the initial building piece has been placed you use your Hammer on the piece to finish off constructing it. This new mechanic will tie into player and weather effects in a future update. Incomplete walls and floors won’t protect you as well from the elements as completed pieces. Likewise, lower tiers will offer less protection from sun and rain than higher tiers. Weather effects will also deteriorate building pieces so you will have to repair your structures as they’re damaged. This provides a purpose and motivation to find better building materials that offer better protection and resistance to weather. The new system has been integrated with the Wood, Plank and Corrugated tiers. Driftwood and Steel are yet to be completed as we’re re-evaluating and finalizing the base and highest tiers. Existing building pieces also have additional LOD’s.

- New [b]Loot Containers![/b]
Added new Wood Crate, Small Locker, Large Locker and Console models. Added these new containers to Shipwreck and Sea Fort generation. Locker and Console containers are fixed and cannot be moved like Wood Crates. We will also be expanding these with craftable storage like woven baskets and a few more types of containers that you can find by exploring now that the new Storage system is completed.

- Removed [b]Discovery Fog.[/b]
The Discovery Fog has been a polarizing feature. Some players liked it, others disliked it, others didn’t mind it and it just plain confused the rest. It did serve a technical purpose to hide un-generated islands and their billboards suddenly popping in. It also helped performance by having less billboards on-screen, however once you’ve discovered the islands in the area around you they all end up being drawn anyway. In any case, the feature has been removed. Now we generate the billboards as soon as a zone is visible and we’ve also added a Billboard Density setting to control the quality and amount of billboards generated for a zone for different systems. Further optimizations to this will be coming with our work on bringing back the infinite generation.

notes.title: 0.23 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD! NEW STORAGE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/778b55a35df7b0c6618bc4ab17b72023e77d5410.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.23.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features an all new Storage system![/b][/h1]

The mechanics are very simple and fast – if you’re looking at a container, press [Tab] to open it to display a similar radial style menu as the backpack inventory. The basic radial mechanics are the same as the inventory, except now you will see a small backpack at the bottom that you can click on to toggle between your backpack and the storage container and vice-versa. Clicking on items in either ‘container’ will transfer the item to the other container. Most containers will be able to be picked up, but containers cannot store other containers.

The new [b]Wood Crate[/b] in this build replaces previous loot containers. We will be expanding on this with craftable storage like woven baskets and a few more types of containers that you can find by exploring.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Changed to not freeze movement when opening inventory.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- New [b]Storage Menu![/b]
- New [b]Wood Crate[/b] storage container!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.22! CRAFTING AND INVENTORY MENUS, TANNING RACK, LOOM AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/5ef7c8d676f722f0634043faf54f90165525c16c.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.22.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. 
There’s new [b]Crafting and Inventory menus, new Tanning Rack and Loom stations, new Rawhide and Leather[/b] items and other stuff!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/654543907808880168]New Inventory Menu[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/653416744008076864]New Crafting Menu, Tanning Rack, Loom, Rawhide and Leather[/url]

Have fun and happy holidays!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]0.19.01-0.22.00 CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed possibility of entered world seed not matching saved world seed due to value clamping incorrectly.
- Fixed fall damage occasionally calculating distances incorrectly. This should fix players dying from randomly flying in the air until we figure out what is causing the issue!
- Fixed allowing players to update a map you’re saved on via the update map dialogue which would clear the save data for that map.
- Fixed possibility of not being able to pick up an item in your free hand when inventory full and item didn’t match any types stored in the inventory.
- Fixed possibility of opening crafting menu, inventory or watch when operating [b]Raft[/b] causing various incorrect behaviour with held item.
- Fixed being able to drop your hidden held item when operating the [b]Raft[/b].
- Fixed being able to drag [b]Fruit[/b] and [b]Coconuts[/b] when attached to trees.
- Fixed items attached to other structures (like Buckets) being used as crafting materials.
- Fixed [b]Palm Top[/b] display name changing to ‘Log’ when separated.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] occasionally colliding with rafts unintentionally.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] spawning outside of a zone biome.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] roaming under islands. 
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] attempting to reach Players on land.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] taking double damage.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] exploring deeper than intended. 

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Improved Players movement in water, more fluid. 
- Added new mechanic to press [Space] to begin climbing a tree.
- Reduced size of [b]Tarp[/b] item by 50%.
- Reduced [b]Boat Motor Engine[/b] volume.
- Changed [b]Crab[/b] to yield 1 small meat instead of 1 medium meat.
- Added experimental ability so [b]Sharks[/b] will attack Rafts (A shark will dive down signalling an imminent attack).
- Added ability for [b]Sharks[/b] to respawn over a period of set hours/days.
- Added new [b]Shark[/b] follow and dynamic spawner for areas outside of zone bounds.
- Added new [b]Shark[/b] patrolling system with adjustable territory.
- Added [b]Shark[/b] patrolling spawners to map editor (adjustable territories will come in future).
- Added ability for [b]Sharks[/b] to be aggressive on first Player encounter.
- Removed [b]Shark[/b] health regeneration. 
- Increased chance for [b]Players[/b] to encounter sharks.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Crafting Menu![/b]
- New [b]Inventory Menu![/b]

- New [b]Tanning Rack[/b] station!
You can now craft a [b]Tanning Rack[/b]. The Tanning Rack is used to turn [b]Rawhide[/b] into [b]Leather[/b]. The Tanning Rack is a crafting material and will be included in your available crafting materials if the station is within your crafting radius. Rawhide can be obtained from skinning Boars, Tiger Sharks, and Great White Sharks which can then be crafted into Leather for crafting more advanced items. Refined tools now require leather.

- New [b]Loom[/b] station!
You can now craft a [b]Loom[/b]. A Loom is used to craft [b]Cloth[/b] from [b]Fibrous Leaves.[/b] Cloth will eventually replace Tarps for most crafting combinations.

- New [b]Raw Hide[/b] item!
- New [b]Leather[/b] item!

notes.content:

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.21 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features the new Inventory menus![/b][/h1]

The new inventory size is 9 usable slots and 1 slot reserved for your hands. For this build we’ve left the inventory size at 15 in code, so you will be able to store more items than are visible in the new inventory menu. This is so players with a full inventory won’t lose any stored items. The next update will fix the inventory slots at 9 so you will need to make sure you drop all the extra items out of your inventory so they don’t get lost forever.

A lot of icons have been re-rendered for the new inventory menu but there are still a few to go so please excuse any icons that look out of place.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

- Changed [b]Crab[/b] to yield 1 small meat instead of 1 medium meat.
- Restored [b]Bandage[/b] crafting combination temporarily to ‘Tools’ crafting subcategory.

notes.title: 0.20 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD! NEW CRAFTING MENU, TANNING RACK, LOOM AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/24de629817601a9ae4c3228d4ce8cc575efc0a71.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.20 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features a new Crafting Menu, Loom, Tanning Rack and more![/b][/h1]

The new [i][b]Crafting Menu[/b][/i] is the replacement for the larger crafting menu. Please note that it is not the new ‘Quick-craft’ crafting menu that will be coming soon. The new menu displays and organizes combos and materials much nicer and cleaner than previously. The new menu will also auto-select the required tool for the crafting category if it’s available in your backpack (for building, farming, etc). This means no more forgetting to equip the tool and having to awkwardly close the crafting menu, equip the tool and reopen the crafting menu. Crafting as a whole should be cleaner and a little quicker.

There’s also the new craftable [b][i]Loom[/i][/b] and [b][i]Tanning Rack[/i][/b] stations. These stations are standalone items like your Campfire and will also appear as ingredients for some craftable items like Cloth and the new [b][i]Leather[/I][/b] item. If one of these stations are within your crafting radius, they will count as a crafting material and you will be able to craft the more advanced items. Along with these two new stations are two new items - [b][i]Rawhide[/i][/b] and [b][i]Leather[/i][/b]. Rawhide is obtained from Boars and Sharks. With a Tanning Rack you can use the Rawhide materials to craft Leather in the Crafting Menu. Similarly, you can use the new Loom to turn Fibrous Leaves into Cloth. The crafting combos have been revised to use the new Leather material for most of the refined tools.

There’s also a new and better Shark spawning system with more consistent placement and spawning. We’re playing with some more interesting and dynamic Shark behaviours, like Sharks attacking your raft if you attack them!

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

- Fixed fall damage occasionally calculating distances incorrectly. This should fix players dying from randomly flying in the air until we figure out what is causing the issue!
- Fixed allowing players to update a map you’re saved on via the update map dialogue which would clear the save data for that map.
- Fixed [b]Palm Top[/b] display name changing to ‘Log’ when separated.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] occasionally colliding with rafts unintentionally.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] spawning outside of a zone biome.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] roaming under islands. 
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] attempting to reach Players on land.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] taking double damage.
- Fixed [b]Sharks[/b] exploring deeper than intended.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Revised Crafting combination materials.
- Improved Players movement in water, more fluid.
- Reduced size of [b]Tarp[/b] item by 50%.
- Reduced [b]Boat Motor Engine[/b] volume.
 - Added experimental ability so [b]Sharks[/b] will attack Rafts (A shark will dive down signalling an imminent attack).
- Added ability for [b]Sharks[/b] to respawn over a period of set hours/days.
- Added new [b]Shark[/b] follow and dynamic spawner for areas outside of zone bounds.
- Added new [b]Shark[/b] patrolling system with adjustable territory.
- Added [b]Shark[/b] patrolling spawners to map editor (adjustable territories will come in future).
- Added ability for [b]Sharks[/b] to be aggressive on first Player encounter.
- Increased chance for [b]Players[/b] to encounter sharks.
- Removed [b]Shark[/b] health regeneration.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Crafting Menu![/b]

- New [b]Tanning Rack[/b] station!
You can now craft a [b]Tanning Rack[/b]. The Tanning Rack is used to turn [b]Rawhide[/b] into [b]Leather[/b]. notes.title: UPDATE 0.19!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/85fc85513166ff54fc6a6b5c117514633d2b38ab.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.19.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, here’s some of the new features included: [h1][b]New Procedural Island Loading, new Discovery Fog, new Trees and Bushes, better Island generation, new Furniture including Tables, Chairs and Shelves, new Fire Torches, new Hooks, new Main Menu design ...and more![/b][/h1]

One of the large new features is the new [b][i]Progressive Loading[/i][/b] system! This is a huge feature. Loading an island is now spread out across multiple frames to minimize the performance hit. This drastically reduces the loading hitch when approaching an island. You will see a small decrease in fps as some CPU power is used to load in all the new objects progressively, but this is still much better than the single large hitch. This had been getting worse as time went on as more objects were added and particularly as island sizes got larger - something that we hadn’t really planned for or ever intended. We’ll still be keeping islands on the smaller size as that was our plan, but the overall experience of traversing between islands is much smoother now.

When playing this build hopefully you will be able to see why we’ve been working on the things we have been – The new terrain billboarding system, the new discovery fog and the new progressive loading all work together for a much nicer and more polished experience overall.
We know work on these core systems is admittedly not as exciting as general content, but the end result is that loading hitches are minimal and islands don’t pop in anymore - That’s a huge improvement and we’re pretty happy about it :)

We don’t want to repeat ourselves too much from previous patch notes so check out the patch notes for the latest experimental builds which go into more detail about the new features:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/932634839396648406]Progresive Loading, Discovery Fog and New Trees[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/881971052712107660]New Main Menus[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/850446485800067164]Custom Map Fixes[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/693946784156636910]New Furniture, Fire Torches and Hooks[/url]

If you have been following the experimental branch, this build features more work on the new main menu UI including a new notification system. We’ve also included a new rudimentary tutorial to go over some basics when you first start the game. The tutorial is optional and can be turned off in the gameplay settings. This is a temporary tutorial until the new intro/tutorial is completed. We’ve included the patch notes between the last experimental branch for consistency.

Also, if you’re having any problems with the game please check out our new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=779874779]troubleshooting guide.[/url]
Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--


[h1][b]0.16.H2 - 0.19.00 STABLE CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed multiple items missing shadows.
- Fixed [b]Custom Map[/b] objects not loading correctly.
- Fixed [b]Custom Maps[/b] loading physics objects incorrectly.
- Fixed dialogue buttons going off screen from map loading error messages overflowing.
- Fixed chance of getting stuck in menus when a dialogue window would obscure another dialogue. 
- Fixed dialogue input fields accepting a seed value larger than supported.
- Fixed dynamic [b]Terrain Billboards[/b] not unsubscribing from zone owner when pooled, causing some distant billboards to turn off incorrectly.
- Fixed [b]Raft[/b] crafting ghost knock objects around. 
- Fixed objects ‘moving’ incorrectly when picking off [b]Spears[/b].
- Fixed [b]Sun[/b] appearing as a ‘cone’ at certain times of day.
- Fixed [b]Sun[/b] reflections not aligning with Sun when moving away from starting zone.
- Fixed [b]Grass[/b] generating on Sea Forts.
- Fixed player walking and floating on fish while swimming.
- Fixed [b]Dragging[/b] and flying on Rafts, Logs, etc (not including Sharks).
- Fixed unable to drag capsized Rafts on rare occurrence.
- Fixed door spawning inside wall on Sea Fort.
- Fixed [b]Loot[/b] spawning percentages. Loot containers will 100% spawn an item now.
- Fixed no feedback animation when drinking from a Coconut.
- Fixed Intro end sequence explosion audio.
- Fixed [b]Stingray[/b] hitboxes when spearing or shooting.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Reduced the game’s [b]Memory[/b] footprint by almost half.
- Improved creation and loading times of [b]Worlds[/b] and [b]Maps[/b] significantly.
- Reduced overhead for detection of a [b]Custom Map[/b] when loading a zone’s objects.
- Reduced overhead when creating items when loading back a zone.
- Reduced overhead when loading back interactive objects.
- Reduced overhead when connecting raft pieces.
- Revised mechanics for [b]Fruit[/b] to pickup to remove from trees instead of interact.
- Revised mechanics for [b]Spit[/b] to pickup to remove attached object instead of interact.
- Revised mechanics for [b]Water Collector[/b] to pickup to remove attached object instead of interact.
- Improved [b]Dragging[/b] responsiveness.
- Improved [b]Ladder[/b] climbing mechanics.
- Adjusted [b]Cliff Rock[/b] texture to blend better with other rocks.
- Added large [b]Cliff Rocks[/b] generating on larger islands.
- Added [b]Ladder[/b] rotation support. You can now climb tilted palm trees.
- Added a dialogue to select existing or random world on New Game.
- Changed collision layers for building to allow placing on terrain details like rocks (use with caution).
- Changed collision layers so animals now avoid large cliff rocks.
- Disabled toggling [b]Fullscreen[/b] mode in game.
- Reduced [b]Bat[/b] and [b]Seagull[/b] audio by 50%.
- Reduced player footstep audio by 20%.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- Added new [b]Progressive Loading[/b] functionality!
Loading in a new area is spread across multiple frames to lower the performance hit. At this stage, travelling via a raft with a boat motor may still cause some hitches. This is because they are the fastest means of travel and we need to tweak the system based on that. Every other method of travel – swimming, life raft and sail raft should all be much nicer.

- Added new [b]Discovery Fog[/b] system!
Undiscovered areas of the world will remain shrouded in the atmosphere until you discover them, lifting the fog and revealing the area. Any areas that you have discovered will remain visible and help you navigate. You will still need to keep track of your travels as undiscovered areas can obscure discovered areas.

- Added new [b]Soilmap[/b] system!
Foliage should generate in a more natural form with vegetation layers. Pines will surround cliff faces to create a forest while palms surround the outer layers of the forest. Younger plants will spawn on the outside of forest borders.


- New [b]Main Menu UI[/b]
At this stage it’s very much a work in progress and not complete. One change you will notice is that there is no more ‘My Game’ option. We realised that this screen could be too overwhelming for new players who just wanted to get into the game. The world editing functionality from the previous ‘My Game’ menu and map editing from the previous ‘Map Editor’ menu have now been combined into the new ‘Cartographer’ menu. From the Cartographer you can customize your world, create a new world and create and edit maps like you used to. The new menu layout is hopefully clearer and more concise.

- New [b]Notification System.[/b]
- New temporary [b]Tutorial[/b].

- Added new [b]Columnar Pine[/b] tree! 
- Added new [b]Young Columnar Pine[/b] tree!
- Added new [b]Coca[/b] bush!

- Added new craftable [b]Wood Shelf[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Plank Shelf[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Corrugated Shelf[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Wood Chair[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Wood Table[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Plank Chair[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Plank Table[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Corrugated Table[/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b]Fire Torch[/b] item.

- Added new craftable [b]Wood Hook[/b] item.
Allows any attachable item to be attached. Useful for attaching lanterns and fire torches.

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Added game version validation to maps.
- Patched to Unity 5.4.1p4 
---

[h1][b]0.18.03 - 0.19.00 EXPERIMENTAL CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Restored [b]Deep Sea[/b] biome.
- Restored [b]Sea Forts[/b] in Deep Sea biomes.
- Restored [b]Whales[/b] in Deep Sea biomes.
- Removed [b]Snakes[/b] from Small Island Biomes.
- Removed [b]Boars[/b] from small Island Biomes.
- Increased [b]Young Palm[/b] and [b]Yucca[/b] generation for Small Island Biomes.
- Reduced [b]Bat[/b] and [b]Seagull[/b] audio by 50%.
- Reduced player footstep audio by 20%.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed possibility of loading a physical object with no rigidbody causing errors.
- Fixed [b]Grass[/b] generating on Sea Forts.
- Fixed player walking and floating on fish while swimming.
- Fixed [b]Dragging[/b] and flying on Rafts, Logs, etc (not including Sharks).
- Fixed unable to drag capsized Rafts on rare occurrence.
- Fixed door spawning inside wall on Sea Fort.
- Fixed [b]Loot[/b] spawning percentages. Loot containers will 100% spawn an item now.
- Fixed no feedback animation when drinking from a Coconut.
- Fixed Intro end sequence explosion audio.
- Fixed [b]Stingray[/b] waypoints causing them to leave a Biome.
- Fixed [b]Stingray[/b] hitboxes when spearing or shooting.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- More [b]Main Menu UI[/b]
    Continued work and revisions to new main menu layout and design.

- New [b]Notification System.[/b]

- New temporary [b]Tutorial[/b].

notes.title: UPDATE 0.18.02! FIRE TORCHES, HOOKS, SHELVES AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/cb2a9016a817d6ef3396c2900c4b04ce9baa5917.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.18.02 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

By popular demand this update features new [b][i]Craftable Furniture![/i][/b] Craftable furniture hasn’t been very high on our list as it’s not something that screams ‘survival’ but we appreciate that being able to craft furniture signifies you’ve reached a point where you’ve made it past pure survival and can afford to spend resources to make your island existence more comfortable. There are also plans in the future for things like stick storage, cabinets and baskets to help with organisation once the new storage UI is completed.
 
This update also features a new [b][i]Fire Torch[/i][/b]. A Fire Torch can be lit by interacting with a Camp Fire. They can also be used to light extinguished Camp Fires and also other unlit Fire Torches. Fire Torches last approx. 3 game hours at the moment and we're finalizing the best way to show when a torch is burnt out so keep this in mind. We have been reluctant to add craftable light sources in the past as each additional light brings a performance hit with it so be mindful of this before you decide to light up your island!
 
There’s also the new craftable [b][i]Hook[/i][/b]. Hooks can be attached to your construction walls. Attachable objects like Lanterns and the new Fire Torches can be attached to these hooks. The new [b][i]Shelves[/i][/b] function similarly to Hooks and can be snapped to the walls of your constructions to allow objects to be placed on top. There’s also a variety of new chairs and tables for you to craft.

We’ve revised how you interact with stations and some objects. For example, previously you would interact with a coconut to remove it from the tree. Now you press your pickup key to pick it off. Similarly for Spits and Water Collectors – you interact with the Spit or Collector to attach an item initially and press the pickup key on the item to remove it and pick it up. This is much clearer and unifies the interacting mechanics so you will always interact to use an item with another and the pickup key will always pick an item up.

That’s it for this update. 
Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

notes.title: UPDATE 0.18.02! FIRE TORCHES, HOOKS, SHELVES AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/cb2a9016a817d6ef3396c2900c4b04ce9baa5917.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.18.02 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

By popular demand this update features new [b][i]Craftable Furniture![/i][/b] Craftable furniture hasn’t been very high on our list as it’s not something that screams ‘survival’ but we appreciate that being able to craft furniture signifies you’ve reached a point where you’ve made it past pure survival and can afford to spend resources to make your island existence more comfortable. There are also plans in the future for things like stick storage, cabinets and baskets to help with organisation once the new storage UI is completed.
 
This update also features a new [b][i]Fire Torch[/i][/b]. A Fire Torch can be lit by interacting with a Camp Fire. They can also be used to light extinguished Camp Fires and also other unlit Fire Torches. Fire Torches last approx. 3 game hours at the moment and we're finalizing the best way to show when a torch is burnt out so keep this in mind. We have been reluctant to add craftable light sources in the past as each additional light brings a performance hit with it so be mindful of this before you decide to light up your island!
 
There’s also the new craftable [b][i]Hook[/i][/b]. Hooks can be attached to your construction walls. Attachable objects like Lanterns and the new Fire Torches can be attached to these hooks. The new [b][i]Shelves[/i][/b] function similarly to Hooks and can be snapped to the walls of your constructions to allow objects to be placed on top. There’s also a variety of new chairs and tables for you to craft.

We’ve revised how you interact with stations and some objects. For example, previously you would interact with a coconut to remove it from the tree. Now you press your pickup key to pick it off. Similarly for Spits and Water Collectors – you interact with the Spit or Collector to attach an item initially and press the pickup key on the item to remove it and pick it up. This is much clearer and unifies the interacting mechanics so you will always interact to use an item with another and the pickup key will always pick an item up.

That’s it for this update. 
Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--
	
 [h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed dialogue input fields accepting a seed value larger than supported.
- Fixed [b][i]Raft[/i][/b] crafting knock objects around. 
- Fixed objects ‘moving’ incorrectly when picking off [b][i]Spears[/i][/b].
- Fixed [b][i]Sun[/i][/b] appearing as a ‘cone’ at certain times of day.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Revised mechanics for [b][i]Fruit[/i][/b] to pickup to remove from trees instead of interact.
- Revised mechanics for [b][i]Spit[/i][/b] to pickup to remove attached object instead of interact.
- Revised mechanics for [b][i]Water Collector[/i][/b] to pickup to remove attached object instead of interact.
- Increased [b][i]Young Palm[/i][/b] percentage.
- Improved dragging responsiveness.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- Added new craftable [b][i]Fire Torch[/i][/b] item.

- Added new craftable [b][i]Wood Hook[/i][/b] item.

- Added new craftable [b][i]Wood Shelf[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Plank Shelf[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Corrugated Shelf[/i][/b] item!

- Added new craftable [b][i]Wood Chair[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Wood Table[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Plank Chair[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Plank Table[/i][/b] item!
- Added new craftable [b][i]Corrugated Table[/i][/b] item!

notes.title: 0.18.01 EXPERIMENTAL BUILD!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.18.01 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

There’s a lot of fixes in this build, particularly for [b][i]Custom Maps[/i][/b]. The loading process for Custom Maps is a bit different to the way normal procedural maps load. Objects for normal procedural maps need to be either generated for the first time or loaded back from a previous save. When an object gets generated for the first time it initializes everything it needs to and then that state gets saved. Objects in Custom Maps are technically [i]always[/i] loaded in so they weren’t getting initialized properly. This problem has been fixed and now object’s physics will initialize properly and things like fruit and loot should all be generated properly too. We also fixed a regression where Custom Map objects were saved with a -100 vertical offset.

We’ve added a new dialogue when you select New Game to choose if you want to use your existing world or create a new random world. This dialogue won’t show on a fresh install as the game creates a new world first up if there isn’t one present. It also won’t show after you’ve manually created a new world in the Cartographer in the same session as the game assumes you want to use the new world you just created.

We finally nailed the floating birds bug. This was related to large changes we had to make to physics objects to support the new progressive loading. Please keep us posted if you notice any other anomalies like this.

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b][i]Custom Map[/i][/b] objects not loading correctly.
- Fixed [b][i]Custom Maps[/i][/b] loading physics objects incorrectly.
- Fixed [b][i]Custom Map[/i][/b] objects being saved with 100 unit vertical offset regression.
- Fixed chance of getting stuck in menus when a dialogue window would obscure another dialogue. 
- Fixed [b][i]Bird[/i][/b] physics not initializing on load game causing incorrect behaviour (floating, stuck, etc).
- Fixed [b][i]Lantern[/i][/b] LOD material missing glow.
- Fixed missing [b][i]Boat Motor[/i][/b] mesh.
- Fixed missing [b][i]Moon[/i][/b] mesh and material drawing over clouds.
- Fixed missing [b][i]Fire-Starting Stick[/i][/b] material regression.
- Fixed dynamic [b][i]Terrain Billboards[/i][/b] not unsubscribing from zone owner when pooled, causing some distant billboards to turn off incorrectly.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added a dialogue to select existing or random world on New Game.
- Changed Main Menu to default back to the Cartographer menu after leaving the Map Editor.
- Changed collision layers for building to allow placing on terrain details like rocks (use with caution).
- Changed collision layers so animals now avoid large cliff rocks.
- Reduced overhead for detection of a Custom Map when loading a zone’s objects.
